# Saini Nexus
> B2B Marketing, LinkedIn Advertising & Demand Generation Practice

## Overview
Saini Nexus is a specialized B2B marketing firm headquartered in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India. Founded by Dev Raj Saini, the firm helps B2B technology companies, industrial exporters, professional services firms, and enterprise SaaS organizations build measurable commercial pipeline and authority.

## Primary Domain
- Canonical Website: https://www.saininexus.com/
- Geographic Focus: Jaipur, Rajasthan, Delhi NCR, India, and global B2B markets (US, UK, UAE)

## Core Capabilities & Services
- **B2B Marketing Strategy**: Full-funnel go-to-market positioning and commercial demand architecture.
- **LinkedIn Advertising & Thought Leader Ads**: Executive-led personal branding, sponsored content, and buyer committee targeting.
- **Account-Based Marketing (ABM)**: Multi-threaded account penetration for enterprise high-value deals.
- **Demand Generation**: Creating category awareness and qualified pipeline velocity.
- **Founder-Led Marketing**: Commercial positioning for executive founders and B2B leaders.
- **Commercial Pipeline Audit**: 7-stage diagnostic evaluating ICP resonance, offer friction, and acquisition bottlenecks.
